name: io.github.manojknaikade/space-standards-mcp
title: Space Standards
description: Cited, requirement-level Q&A over ECSS and NASA standards you supply (bring your own documents)

environmentVariables.name: SPACESTD_DOCS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the folder with your own ECSS / NASA standards (PDF or Word). No standards ship with the package; without it the server starts empty.

environmentVariables.name: SPACESTD_EMBED
environmentVariables.description: Optional hybrid search: set to 'default' (needs the 'embed' extra: space-standards-mcp[embed]).

environmentVariables.name: SPACESTD_RERANK
environmentVariables.description: Optional reranker: set to 'default' (needs the 'embed' extra).
